name: Peperomia caperata 'Ripple Red'
description: Peperomia caperata 'Ripple Red' is a compact cultivar of the Emerald Ripple Peperomia, native to Brazil. It features the same distinctive heart-shaped, deeply corrugated leaves as the species, but with rich red to burgundy foliage that intensifies in bright indirect light. The rippled or quilted leaf surface gives the plant its name and adds texture. It has a compact, bushy growth habit, typically reaching 15–30 cm in height and spread indoors. Like the species, it grows as an understory plant in tropical forests and thrives in warm, humid conditions with filtered light. Small white flower spikes may appear on long stems, but it is grown mainly for its striking red, textured foliage. Well-suited to terrariums and indoor settings; non-toxic and safe for pets.
careTips: Provide bright, indirect light to maintain red leaf color – avoid direct sun
Allow the top inch of soil to dry between waterings
Water thoroughly but avoid overwatering to prevent root rot
Use well-draining soil to prevent waterlogging
Fertilize every 4–6 weeks during the growing season with diluted fertilizer
Reduce watering in fall and winter
